{{Quote|Now that you've been identified, a prison transport will take you back to Coruscant.|Jedi Padawan [[Tasi Lowa]], to Osha Aniseya|<ref name="Lost / Found" />}}
The '''''Palwick''''' was a [[DTE-CSA-17 Calaboose prison ship]]<ref name="Databank" /> that operated during the [[High Republic Era]], ferrying a number of [[prisoner]]s to [[Coruscant]]. The [[meknek]] [[Verosha Aniseya|Osha Aniseya]], incriminated for the [[Death|murder]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] by her [[twin]] sister [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae]], was held aboard the [[prison]] [[transport]]. While in [[hyperspace]], the other convicts plotted to escape the [[starship]], deactivating the [[Variable geometry droid|pilot droids]] and destroying the [[Variable geometry droid|droid warden]], using its [[Limb|arm]] to open their cells. As the transport dropped out of hyperspace over [[Carlac]], the prisoners fled in an [[escape pod]], leaving Aniseya and [[Melo Tolicus|another convict]] behind. When Aniseya attempted to help the other convict, the prisoner ran to the last escape pod and abandoned her. The transport soon crashed onto Carlac, although Aniseya survived, while the other convicts were recaptured by the [[Jedi Order]]. Jedi Master [[Sol]], his [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]], and the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]] investigated the wreckage of the transport, eventually locating Aniseya on Carlac.<ref name="Lost / Found" />
